results.pair_summary: Doc A defines low-level LLM runtime primitives and types integrated with Chron-LLM Kernel structures (WAL, LogicalClock). Doc B implements a high-level generation orchestration module that consumes Doc A's primitives while adding Delta3-specific immune system monitoring (entropy checks) and fault recovery logic.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A establishes the canonical Runtime Interface ensuring strict state invariants and Kernel alignment. Doc B represents a specific Agent Policy/Orchestration layer that relies on A's primitives to implement safety-critical generation flows (immune sensors, rollback). Merging them would conflate core API definitions with domain-specific execution policies, violating separation of concerns required by the Delta3 architecture.
